jobs.project: Checkout Platform · Web + Mobile (Next.js, Node, GraphQL, GCP)
points: Owned and scaled Checkout APIs in Node.js + Express on Google Cloud Run / GKE Autopilot, handling 300K+ concurrent sessions across web and mobile at 99.98% uptime with zero customer-impacting outages.

Redesigned the API orchestration layer with Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Redis caching, and Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL — cut average checkout latency from 3.2s to 280ms, drove an 18% drop in cart abandonment and multi-million-dollar conversion lift.
Engineered a caching-first architecture on Redis + Google Cloud Memorystore for sub-100ms eligibility lookups, boosting enterprise bulk-order conversions by 22%.
Implemented resilience patterns — circuit breakers, retries, timeouts, fallback APIs — cutting incident MTTR by 45% and preventing cascading failures during peak sales.
Built CI/CD pipelines for Node.js services with Jenkins + Kubernetes + canary deploys on GKE, reducing deployment rollback time by 70%.
Developed and shipped React UI components in JavaScript/TypeScript, integrating REST and GraphQL backends to deliver high-performance user workflows.
Partnered with security + platform teams on OAuth2 and Google Cloud API Gateway / Apigee rate limiting to keep transaction flows PCI-DSS compliant and secure.
Defined SLO targets and built observability dashboards in Prometheus + Grafana to track error budgets and monitor Checkout API health — proactively catching degradation before customer impact.

Led frontend code reviews and contributed to component library standards for checkout-adjacent React components, enforcing TypeScript type safety and cross-platform consistency across web and mobile surfaces.

Coordinated cross-team API design sessions and authored technical specs reviewed by platform, security, and product teams — ensuring new feature delivery aligned with PCI-DSS compliance and GCP architecture guidelines.
Owned post-launch monitoring and incident runbooks for Checkout services — participated in on-call rotations, triaged P0/P1 incidents, and drove root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

Engineered an async event pipeline on Google Cloud Pub/Sub with a Redis (Memorystore) caching layer, enriching recommendation services with user behavior, spending patterns, and merchant context — lifting personalization accuracy across millions of users.

Ran A/B testing experiments using Terraform / Cloud Deployment Manager and internal experimentation frameworks; identified a model variant that drove a 12% improvement in personalized credit-card offer adoption.

Integrated PyTorch models into Node.js + Express backends deployed on Google Cloud Vertex AI and Cloud Run / GKE to power dynamic product and rewards recommendations — 92% prediction accuracy on customer-intent classification.
Built React + Next.js frontends backed by GraphQL APIs, delivering responsive, personalized experiences for shopper-facing and merchant-dashboard workflows.
Owned end-to-end delivery: feature design, API contracts, frontend integration, deployment on GCP, and post-launch monitoring.
Designed a feature-flag system for controlled rollout of updated recommendation models to targeted user cohorts — enabling risk-free production experiments with instant rollback capability.
Set up Cloud Monitoring and Stackdriver alerts for the recommendation pipeline — tracking model prediction latency, cache hit rates, and SLO compliance across staging and production.
Authored API contracts and technical design documents reviewed by data science, backend, and frontend teams — establishing shared event schemas and service integration patterns adopted across teams.
Refactored GraphQL resolver layer to use DataLoader batching — eliminated N+1 query patterns on the recommendation service, reducing database round-trips by 70% under high fan-out reads.

jobs.project: Rewards & Redemption Platform (React, Spring Boot, AWS)
points: Implemented an atomic redemption and inventory system on Spring Boot using Redis Lua scripts, Kafka, and DynamoDB to guarantee fairness and prevent oversells — scaling reliably to 100K+ concurrent redemptions/sec during major campaigns.

Integrated the rewards platform with payments using the saga pattern, ensuring transactional consistency between financial settlements and reward credits and reducing customer-impacting reconciliation issues by 70%.

Developed React-based internal dashboards for finance and compliance teams to monitor balances, reward inventory, and anomalies in real time — improving audit-prep time by 60% through transparent, drill-down UIs.
Wrote unit and integration tests for React apps with Jest + React Testing Library, raising UI reliability and confidence in production releases.
Defined system SLOs and built an observability stack on Grafana + Prometheus with custom alerts and on-call runbooks, cutting incident MTTR from hours to minutes.
Participated in high-concurrency load testing and chaos engineering exercises to validate redemption system resilience — identified and resolved race conditions before major campaign launches.
Contributed to internal engineering wiki — documenting Kafka consumer retry patterns, DynamoDB hot-key mitigation strategies, and Redis Lua scripting patterns adopted by the wider backend team.
Collaborated with QA, compliance, and finance teams on audit preparation — built transaction drill-down views and automated reconciliation reports that reduced manual review cycles by 40%.
Worked closely with product managers to translate business rules for reward tiers and expiry logic into reliable backend services with full test coverage and regression suites.

projects.name: MatchingDB
projects.tagline: MERN-based workforce-management platform with a micro-frontend architecture — live at matchingdb.com.
projects.why: Built for myself to connect candidates and employers and run my own hiring / payroll / invoicing / timesheets / immigration tracking flows end-to-end.
bullets: Micro-frontend architecture — Shell UI host + Jobs UI remote via Module Federation.
Three Node.js services: shell-services (auth/Stripe/gateway), jobs-services (jobs/RBAC/financials/GraphQL), notification-services (activity/email).
Apollo GraphQL API with DataLoader batching; Redis caching layer for per-user reads with mutation-driven eviction.
Stripe payments, RBAC, JWT + Google OAuth, SSR for public pages.
Win97 / Classic / Modern theme engine — three full visual languages on one platform.
MongoDB Atlas (3 DBs), React 18, Express, Node.js — self-hosted.
